entities.summary: Abu l-Hasan Kūshyār ibn Labbān ibn Bashahrī al-Jīlī (971–1029), also known as Kushyar ibn Labban, was an Iranian mathematician, geographer, and astronomer from Gilan, south of the Caspian Sea, Iran. Author of Principles of Hindu Reckoning.
